liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Louie Louie** (2 reviews): Louie Louie was one of only a few performances of the song; Louie Louie is the highlight: a cover transformed drastically yet smoothly, original and rocking [11][22]
- **Mississippi Half-Step** (1 review): Jerry can be heard suppressing laughter several times in the first half minute of Half-Step [19]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Franklin's confirms Jerry is in solid form [15]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone is described as very powerful [20]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Jerry scorches Watchtower at the climax of the show [11]
- **Black Muddy River** (1 review): Even the encore Black Muddy River rocked, with great energy [13]

## Setlist highlights

- **Louie Louie**: rare: 9 archived performances [23]

## The recordings

- **gd88-04-22.sbd-matrix.hinko.26818.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 152 min; rated 2.71/5 by 7 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the matrix sound unimpressive, though heard on a small shelf stereo with bass boost [21]
- **gd1988-04-22.152577.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min [2]
- **gd1988-04-22.152289.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min [3]
- **gd88-04-22.aud.wiley.16070.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer who attended says the audience tape sounds as good as they remember the night; Reviewer, usually not an audience-tape fan, says this one conveys the feeling of actually being there [11][13]
- **gd1988-04-22.164110.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 151 min [5]

## Around the show

- The taping pair recorded all six 1987 and 1988 Irvine shows from the same seats, arranged via the band's ticket office [12]
- Opens a three-night stand at an Orange County amphitheatre where the parking lot is visible from every seat [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd88-04-22.sbd-matrix.hinko.26818.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Darryl Hinko; source: flac16 SBD (Matrix) > MC > DAT > CD > EAC > FLAC [1]
- **gd1988-04-22.152577.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 21, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [2]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple masters combined to complete the show; 24-bit converted to 16-bit at 44.1 [2]
- **gd1988-04-22.152289.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 21, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [3]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; multiple masters used to make the show complete [3]
- **gd88-04-22.aud.wiley.16070.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD(unknown mics/deck)> PCM> DAT> CDR [4]. Also: Taped by the reviewer and Sean Weber: Schoeps CMC44 in ORTF into a Sony PCM-F1, Row DD, section 6 center; Paul B received a few of the shows from the taper's PCM master [12]
- **gd1988-04-22.164110.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.mattes.miller.clugston.flac16**: taped by Don Crandall, Sean Weber-Small  & Chris Huron; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Don Crandall, Sean Weber-Small & Chris Huron's (FOB) Audience PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100); Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics (ORTF) (Ted Mattes' equipment) [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1988-04-22 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1988-04-22-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [24]
